idea.title: Good results fine tuning a local LLM like Qwen 3:0.6B to categorize questions

plan.tagline: Fine-tunes a local LLM to categorize questions with high accuracy
plan.problem: Small businesses and developers struggle to efficiently categorize questions without relying on expensive or complex cloud-based solutions
plan.solution: QwenCat fine-tunes a local LLM, allowing users to train and deploy a custom question categorization model on their own machine, using a simple CLI interface to add, list, and report on categorized questions
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide who need a cost-effective and easy-to-use question categorization solution
mvp_features: CLI interface for adding and listing categorized questions

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: Design and implement sqlite schema, add and list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Implement report generation and notification functionality

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Implement --demo mode, --help documentation, and edge case handling

plan.demo_script: Demonstrates QwenCat's ability to fine-tune a local LLM, add and list categorized questions, and generate reports, all offline with hardcoded data
